a_before_b.rationale: Evaluating all system components is a broad system-level skill, while downstream task evaluation is a specific dataset-quality assessment method that does not require prior mastery of full AI system evaluation.

b_before_a.rationale: Assessing dataset quality via downstream tasks is not required to meaningfully understand how to evaluate domain-specific capability, generation capability, instruction-following, cost, and latency across an entire AI system.
